tornado-cash.description: Each line is one fixed-denomination pool, counting the addresses that deposited into it.

railgun.description: Railgun deposits are arbitrary amounts, so each line counts the addresses that deposited at least that much of a token - two sizes per token, worth roughly 0.1 and 10 ETH.

privacy-pools.description: Privacy Pools deposits are arbitrary amounts, so each line counts the addresses that deposited at least that much of a token - two sizes per token, worth roughly 0.1 and 10 ETH.
